title: Le Passé Composé vs L'Imparfait
description: Completed events against background and habits.

items.translation: A completed action or a single event
items.hint: Signals: hier, soudain, tout à coup, un jour, ce matin

items.translation: Background, description, habit, or an action in progress
items.exampleEn: It was raining and I was tired.
items.hint: Signals: d'habitude, souvent, tous les jours, autrefois, quand j'étais petit

items.translation: Imparfait sets the scene; passé composé interrupts it
items.exampleFr: Je dormais quand le téléphone a sonné.
items.exampleEn: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

items.prompt: Quand j'étais petit, je ___ au foot tous les jours.
items.translation: When I was little, I played football every day.
Yesterday, I saw a good film.
It was raining when I went out.
We used to live in Lyon.

items.prompt: Ce matin, elle ___ à huit heures.
items.translation: This morning, she left at eight.

items.prompt: Je ___ la télé quand tu as appelé.
items.translation: I was watching TV when you called.
Last year, they went to Italy.

items.prompt: Il ___ beau et les oiseaux chantaient.
items.translation: The weather was nice and the birds were singing.

items.prompt: D'habitude, je ___ le bus, mais hier j'ai pris un taxi.
items.translation: Usually I took the bus, but yesterday I took a taxi.
She was reading when her brother came in.

items.prompt: Quand il était jeune, il ___ beaucoup de sport.
items.translation: When he was young, he did a lot of sport.

items.prompt: Which tense describes a background scene in the past?
Which tense tells a completed, one-time action?
Tous les étés, nous ___ à la mer.
Un jour, j'___ un chien dans la rue.
Which expression usually signals the imparfait?
Which expression usually signals the passé composé?
